note: Hand orientations, stated as the direction the fingers point and the direction the palm faces.

PALM_OUT.description: Fingers up, palm toward the viewer

PALM_IN.description: Fingers up, palm toward the signer

PALM_ACROSS.description: Fingers up, palm toward the midline

PALM_SIDE.description: Fingers up, palm away from the midline

FINGERS_FORWARD.description: Fingers forward, palm toward the midline

FINGERS_ACROSS.description: Fingers toward the midline, palm toward the signer

FINGERS_ACROSS_DOWN.description: Fingers toward the midline, palm down

FINGERS_DOWN.description: Fingers down, palm toward the signer

ANGLED_OUT.description: Fingers up and away from the midline, palm forward

ANGLED_IN.description: Fingers up and toward the midline, palm forward, as a salute sits

ANGLED_DOWN.description: Fingers up and forward, palm forward and down
